content_of_post_to_comment: There are 5 major religions in the world with conflicting perceptions of what reality is, what good is, and what a human is. Each has existed for over 1000 years. That whole time, we never “aligned” on which moral framework was true. We only fractured further. Wars were fought. So why are we thinking we’ll be able to “solve” AI alignment? How can we align AI when we’ve already proven that we can’t even align ourselves?
comment: Maybe the goal of AI alignment shouldn't be agreement on what is good, but the ability to coexist amid disagreement. The harder question is who gets to define the boundaries.
